definitions.gloss: norm; usual state; what is ordinary
definitions.explanation: What is normal, customary, or to be expected. Often appears in set patterns describing how things typically are, or as {常|つね}に (always) adverbially.

examples.english: That's the way of the world.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}は{若者|わかもの}の{常|つね}だ。
examples.english: Failure is to be expected from young people.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{常|つね}に{冷静|れいせい}でいるよう{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: He always tries to stay calm.

notes:
A somewhat literary noun. Most common as part of fixed patterns: 〜の{常|つね} (the way of ~), {常|つね}に (always), or {常々|つねづね} (regularly, all the time).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {世|よ}の{常|つね}: the way of the world
- ~の{常|つね}: typical of, what's normal for ~
- {常|つね}に: always (adverbial)
- {常|つね}{日頃|ひごろ}: regularly; in everyday life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いつも: always — everyday, conversational
- {普段|ふだん}: usually; in ordinary times — concrete daily routine
- {常|つね}に: always — formal, written; same kanji used adverbially
